## IMessageReportingConfig.tsdocMessageReporting property

How to handle TSDoc messages. Maps message IDs to reporting rules.

**Signature:**

```typescript
tsdocMessageReporting?: Record<string, IMessageReportingRule>;
```

## Remarks

Use 'default' as a key to set the default rule for all TSDoc messages. Specific message IDs can override the default.
